schedule:
Week 1 – Course Overview & Network Foundations
Introduction to network architecture, layering principles, performance metrics (delay, throughput), and system abstraction.

Week 2 – Network Abstractions and Design Principles
Protocol layering, encapsulation, end-to-end argument, and system design trade-off.

Week 3 – Framing and Error Detection
Framing techniques, error detection (CRC), reliable transmission over point-to-point links.

Week 4 – Media Access Control and LAN Technologies
Multiple access protocols, Ethernet, switching, and wireless LAN fundamentals.

Week 5 – Switching and Forwarding
Packet switching fundamentals, store-and-forward, queueing basics.

Week 6 – Routing Algorithms
Distance-vector and link-state routing; shortest-path algorithms.

Week 7 – Internet Protocol (IP)
IP addressing, subnetting, CIDR, IPv4/IPv6, ARP.

Week 8 – Internet Routing and BGP
Interdomain routing, BGP fundamentals, Internet architecture.

Week 9 – Midterm Examination

Week 10 – Transport Layer Fundamentals
End-to-end communication, multiplexing, UDP and TCP overview.

Week 11 – Reliable Data Transfer
Sliding window protocols, flow control, TCP mechanisms.

Week 12 – Congestion Control Mechanisms
TCP congestion control algorithms (slow start, AIMD, fast recovery).

Week 13 – Resource Allocation and QoS
Fairness, scheduling algorithms, quality of service principles.

Week 14 – Distributed Systems and Data Delivery
RPC, distributed storage concepts, content distribution.

Week 15 – Network Security Fundamentals
Threat models, cryptographic foundations, secure channels (TLS).

Week 16 – Application Layer Protocols
HTTP, DNS, email protocols, application design patterns.

Week 17 – Emerging Topics and System Integration
Cloud networking, SDN overview, performance evaluation, student presentations (if applicable).

Week 18 – Final Examination
